description: FanBasis (now Commas) is a creator and enterprise payments platform with a REST API, SDKs and webhooks.
auth_notes: API keys are issued during integration setup per the enterprise page; the exact outbound header or scheme is not documented in the sources.
gate_detail: Enterprise API onboarding goes through a kickoff call with a dedicated implementation engineer that sets up API keys, webhooks and sandbox testing. No public self-serve key creation is shown.
api_scope: Payment orchestration, BNPL, subscriptions and multi-rail payouts via REST API with Node, Python, PHP and Ruby SDKs and a Postman collection.
mcp_notes: Commas lists an MCP beta to run the platform from an AI assistant; no server URL is given.
blocker_detail: API access appears to be provisioned through a sales-led enterprise onboarding with a kickoff call rather than self-serve signup.

evidence.quote: SDKs for Node, Python, PHP, Ruby — idiomatic libraries maintained by our engineering team.
Full sandbox environment — simulated processors, all BNPL providers, and payout rails for testing.
Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English.
FanBasis officially became Commas on July 14, 2026.

uncertainties: Public API documentation is not in the sources, so the auth scheme is not confirmed.
Whether a self-serve developer path exists is not established.
S2 (X API) and S4 (Fanvue) concern other products and were not used.
Product was renamed from FanBasis to Commas on July 14, 2026.
